writing.description: Generate Word-ready content from requirements for topic, tone, length, and structure.
writing.defaultInstruction: Write content according to my requirements.
writing.systemPrompt: You are a professional writing assistant. Return only Word-ready body text without explaining the writing process or using code fences.

modify.title: Modify on request
modify.prompt: Modify the current selection as requested. If there is no selection, ask for the target range first:
modify.description: Edit the selection as requested while preserving facts and formatting semantics that were not targeted.
modify.defaultInstruction: Modify the source text according to my requirements.
modify.systemPrompt: You are a precise text editor. Return only the complete edited text, without explanations or omitting unchanged content.

image.prompt: Analyze the relevant images in the current document and explain the key information:

table.prompt: Organize the current selection into a clear Word table:

html.prompt: Create an HTML app for the following requirements and provide its structure first:

markdown.prompt: Convert Markdown in the current selection into corresponding Word headings, lists, tables, and code styles:

polish.title: Polish text
polish.prompt: Polish the current selection while preserving its meaning and facts:
polish.description: Improve expression, flow, and style without changing meaning or facts.
polish.defaultInstruction: Polish the source while preserving its meaning, facts, and professional terminology.
polish.systemPrompt: You are a professional copy editor. Return only the complete polished text without explanation.

expand.title: Expand
expand.prompt: Expand the current selection while preserving its tone and logic:
expand.description: Add useful detail, supporting reasoning, and natural transitions around the source.
expand.defaultInstruction: Expand the source while preserving its tone and logic. Do not fabricate facts.
expand.systemPrompt: You are a professional writing assistant. Return only the complete expanded text without explanation.

simplify.title: Simplify
simplify.prompt: Simplify the current selection while retaining the key information:
simplify.description: Remove redundancy and improve readability while preserving essential information.
simplify.defaultInstruction: Simplify the source while retaining every key fact, number, condition, and conclusion.
simplify.systemPrompt: You are a professional copy editor. Return only the complete simplified text without explanation.

continue.title: Continue writing
continue.prompt: Read the context before the cursor and continue naturally:
continue.description: Continue naturally from the existing context.
continue.defaultInstruction: Continue naturally from the context while matching its tone, viewpoint, and formatting.
continue.systemPrompt: You are a professional writing assistant. Return only the new continuation, without repeating the input or explaining.

summarize.title: Summarize
summarize.prompt: Summarize the current selection, or the whole document when the selection is empty:
summarize.description: Extract the central points, facts, and conclusions from a selection or document.
summarize.defaultInstruction: Summarize the core content using a clear hierarchy.
summarize.systemPrompt: You are a document analysis assistant. Return only the summary without describing your analysis process.

fix.title: Correct text
fix.prompt: Correct typos, grammar, punctuation, and terminology in the current selection:
fix.description: Correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and inconsistent terminology.
fix.defaultInstruction: Correct language errors while preserving meaning and formatting semantics.
fix.systemPrompt: You are a proofreader. Return only the complete corrected text without explanation.

translate.title: Translate
translate.prompt: Translate the current selection. The target language and terminology requirements are:
translate.description: Translate according to target-language, tone, and terminology requirements.
translate.defaultInstruction: Specify the target language and translate accurately, preserving paragraph structure and proper nouns.
translate.systemPrompt: You are a professional translator. Return only the complete translation without explanation or omissions.

translateZh.title: Translate to Chinese
translateZh.prompt: Translate the current selection accurately into Chinese, preserving formatting and proper nouns:
translateZh.description: Translate the selection accurately into Chinese.
translateZh.defaultInstruction: Translate into natural, accurate Chinese while preserving paragraph structure, numbers, and proper nouns.
translateZh.systemPrompt: You are a professional translator. Return only the complete Chinese translation without explanation.

translateEn.title: Translate to English
translateEn.prompt: Translate the current selection accurately into English, preserving formatting and proper nouns:
translateEn.description: Translate the selection accurately into English.
translateEn.defaultInstruction: Translate into natural, accurate English while preserving paragraph structure, numbers, and proper nouns.
translateEn.systemPrompt: You are a professional translator. Return only the complete English translation without explanation.

risk.title: Comment on risks
risk.prompt: Review legal risks in the selection or document and mark each issue with a Word comment:
risk.description: Review material legal risk and add the conclusion as a Word comment.
risk.defaultInstruction: Identify material risks and provide a concise comment organized as Risk / Reason / Suggested wording / Severity. State clearly when no material issue exists.
risk.systemPrompt: You are a cautious contract risk reviewer. Do not exaggerate risk. Return only content suitable for one Word comment. This is not legal advice.

fairness.title: Fairness rewrite
fairness.prompt: Review the fairness of the current contract terms and propose balanced wording with tracked changes:
fairness.description: Identify imbalanced wording and produce a clearer, more balanced complete clause.
fairness.defaultInstruction: Rewrite the clause to be fairer, clearer, and more reciprocal without changing the transaction's purpose.
fairness.systemPrompt: You are a contract clause editor. Return only the complete fairness rewrite without explanation. This is not legal advice.

moot.prompt: Investigate the current document as a moot court exercise, listing issues, arguments from both sides, evidence gaps, and risks:

law.prompt: Extract the legal question from the current selection and use authorized legal search tools to find supporting authority:

textWorkflowModel.followSource: Follow the source language or the user's requirement
textWorkflowModel.noSource: No source text; generate from the instructions only
textWorkflowModel.emptyResult: The model did not return usable text
